Title: [Q] Can a tapped minion play Blanket of Night

Messages.Author: Stefan Ferenci
Messages.Body:
I know tapped minions can play action modifiers, but what about the tap part
of blanket of night

AT

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Stefan Ferenci wrote:
>
> I know tapped minions can play action modifiers, but what about the tap part
> of blanket of night

No. Tapped minions cannot tap "to" cause some effect.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3c4de817$0$16258$3b21...@news.univie.ac.at>, Stefan Ferenci

<a950...@nospamunet.univie.ac.at> writes:
>I know tapped minions can play action modifiers, but what about the tap part
>of blanket of night

The minion has to tap for the effect to occur. Tapped minions cannot
tap.
